title: Custom Bootstrap Design System
objective: A documented token and component system with colors, type scale, spacing rules, custom component variants, and examples.

milestones.title: Token inventory
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate token inventory in the UI.
Record a manual test and a relevant edge case.

milestones.title: Typography and spacing scale
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate typography and spacing scale in the UI.
Record a manual test and a relevant edge case.

milestones.title: Component variants
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate component variants in the UI.
Record a manual test and a relevant edge case.

milestones.title: Theme examples
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate theme examples in the UI.
Record a manual test and a relevant edge case.

milestones.title: Usage/accessibility guide
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate usage/accessibility guide in the UI.
Record a manual test and a relevant edge case.

starter_files.purpose: Semantic page shell with viewport metadata and pinned Bootstrap 5.3.8 CDN CSS.
Application-specific overrides only where utilities and component variables are insufficient.
Setup, feature inventory, test matrix, and known limitations.

stretch_features: Add a carefully documented theme or utility customization where it improves consistency.
Add an automated visual or interaction regression check where the local tooling supports it.

tests.name: Responsive layout
steps: Test narrow, medium, and wide widths.
Check for horizontal overflow and content clipping.

tests.name: Keyboard and focus
steps: Use only the keyboard to reach and operate every control.
Confirm focus remains visible and returns after dialogs close.

tests.name: Semantic and content review
steps: Verify heading hierarchy, labels, table headings, and link purpose.
Confirm errors and status are not communicated by color alone.

tests.name: Production readiness
steps: Build or validate with the stated local method.
Inspect all asset paths and remove temporary debugging rules.

review_method: Automated required-file/string smoke check where applicable plus human review of behavior, responsiveness, accessibility, and rationale. Visual correctness requires an actual browser review.
status_note: Draft project brief; the reference is an architecture/review guide, not a claim of production-complete application behavior.
